name: commitly
description: Code. Think. Ship. — and let your commits take care of themselves.

commands.title: Commitly: Set Groq API Key (unlock a better AI model)

commitly.idleThreshold.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle auto-commit.

commitly.groupChangesWithin.description: Seconds to group edits into a single auto-commit window.

commitly.ai.enabled.description: Generate commit messages with AI. Falls back to a built-in heuristic whenever AI is unavailable, rate-limited, or produces an invalid message.

enumDescriptions: Use your own Groq key if set, otherwise the free hosted tier.
Always use the free hosted tier (Commitly proxy).
Always use your own Groq key (falls back to heuristic if no key is set).
commitly.ai.tier.description: Which AI backend to use. Add your own Groq key (command: 'Commitly: Set Groq API Key') to unlock a more capable model.

commitly.ai.model.description: Groq model id to use with your own key. Empty uses the default capable model (openai/gpt-oss-120b). Ignored on the free tier.

commitly.ai.proxyUrl.description: Endpoint for the free hosted commit-message tier. Override to self-host the proxy.

commitly.ai.includeBody.description: Allow AI to add a short commit body below the subject line.

commitly.ai.maxDiffBytes.description: Maximum diff size (bytes) sent for message generation. Larger changes are summarized.

commitly.ai.timeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for a message-generation request before falling back to the heuristic.

commitly.ai.minIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval (ms) between AI calls per repository; bursts within this window use the heuristic.

commitly.ignorePatterns.description: Simple ignore patterns for auto-commit eligibility.

commitly.lineChangeThreshold.description: Approximate changed line threshold that can trigger an auto-commit.

commitly.fileChangeThreshold.description: Changed file count threshold that can trigger an auto-commit.

commitly.blockOnDiagnostics.description: Block auto-commit if any changed file has VS Code diagnostics with severity Error.

commitly.branchRelevance.description: Block auto-commit when branch name implies fix/feat and message type doesn't match.

commitly.testTaskNameIncludes.description: Task name substrings treated as test runs for the test-pass trigger.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
